entry.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry.action: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 50.7. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry.action_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 50.7 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

profile.description: Par Pacific Holdings is a Houston-based American oil and gas exploration and production company. Known as Par Petroleum Corporation after it emerged from bankruptcy, it was renamed Par Pacific Holdings on October 20, 2015.
profile.description_zh: Par Pacific Holdings 是一家总部位于休斯顿的美国石油天然气勘探与生产公司，破产重组后曾名为Par Petroleum Corporation，并于2015年10月20日更名为Par Pacific Holdings。
